Home Music News Drama Swirls in Argentina After John Summit Set Appears to End Early

Drama Swirls in Argentina After John Summit Set Appears to End Early

By
Bryson Page
-
September 13, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:40
Instaread

During his September 12, 2026 show at Mandarine Park in Buenos Aires, Argentina, Dance superstar John Summit abruptly wrapped up his set at 5:20 AM, 40 minutes shy of the venue’s advertised 6:00 AM end time. This frustrated fans who had long been sold a “three-hour set” that Summit would play in the southern capital. It seems unlikely that anybody would book a 2 hour and 20 minutes set, so it’s more likely that they booked 2 hours and he played a bit more.

The early exit left fans confused and sparked heated debate online, where attendees voiced frustration over logistics and expectations. Beyond missing out on those 40 minutes, fans reported a lack of explanation as to why this happened.

On Sunday Summit himself went on a Reddit thread, leaving a short message giving some context. Along those lines he wrote: “promoter should’ve booked a closer after me if they wanted party going on that much later“. He also criticized the crowd’s reaction: “i gave it my best, sad to see how unappreciative the crowd was about it but it is what it is.“

The situation basically divided the opinions into two teams: while some attendees accused Summit of being disrespectful by walking off without an explanation, others placed the blame squarely on the event producers, PM Open Air, highlighting Summit’s gruelling performance schedule and arguing that the promoters overpromised set lengths without aligning with the artist’s itinerary.

As of today, the producers haven’t shared a statement. Summit’s touring schedule continued to Rio de Janeiro for the next dates of his ongoing album tour. What do you think? Are the fans being too harsh here?
